lines: Before you react to a strong emotion
try to understand what you're really feeling.
And sometimes, what feels like stress
When you put your feelings into words
you may find it easier to understand them.
“What exactly is making me feel this way?”
You cannot control every emotion you feel
but you can learn to understand it
that can change the way you see life.
Follow for more daily psychology about people and relationships.
